description: Canon 1DMarkII digital camera: normalized R, G and B channel spectral sensitivities (400-720 nm, 10 nm steps) from the RIT Camera Spectral Sensitivity Database (Jiang et al. 2013).
short_description: Canon 1DMarkII camera RGB sensitivities (Jiang et al. 2013)
facility_description: Digital cameras (DSLRs, mirrorless, compact, industrial, cinema and phone cameras) whose RGB channel spectral sensitivities or internal IR/UV-cut filter transmissions have been measured.
notes: RGB curves checked this session: NJM values are identical (max abs diff 0) to the 'Canon 5DMarkII' entry of http://www.gujinwei.org/research/camspec/camspec_database.txt. WARNING: NJM/SVO 'Canon_1DMarkII' curves are identical to the database's 'Canon 5DMarkII' entry; the RIT database has no 1D Mark II (it has a 1D Mark III, which differs by up to 0.29). The instrument is probably mislabelled upstream (SVO); the curves are really the Canon EOS 5D Mark II.
